lines: If you commented on my posts, you are in this video.
Every name here is a real person, fighting a real war in my comments.
One thousand eight hundred and sixty-one of them. In the order they enlisted.
Your soldier has a name, a family and a diary. Some have already died. Some are still holding the line.
Not here yet? Comment Hegemony or Concord. You will be in the next one.
